image_description: A male musician performing on a stage, holding an electric guitar. He is wearing a light blue striped shirt and beige trousers. A microphone stand is positioned in front of him. The background is dark with some visible stage rigging and faint text projection. The foreground shows the edge of the stage platform.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Faint projected text in the background appears distorted and partially illegible ('...octob...'), typical of AI struggling with background typography.
The connection between the guitarist's hands and the guitar neck/body is ambiguous; the fingers seem to merge slightly with the instrument rather than gripping it distinctly.
The mechanical joints of the microphone stand lack clear definition and appear somewhat melted or fused together.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the scene classification as a 'stage' and distinguish it from generic concert halls or studios.
To audit the structural integrity of the human subject, specifically limb count and hand-guitar interaction.
To verify the 3D spatial relationship between the performer, the stage floor, and the background rigging.
To analyze the legibility and structure of the faint text in the background.
To detect subtle texture inconsistencies or blending artifacts in the clothing and instruments.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the guitarist's hands. AI often fails at complex finger placements on fretboards. Check if the fingers are distinct or if they melt into the guitar neck. Also, verify if the microphone stand has a logical physical structure or if it appears to float/fuse.
